title: OpenBMT 502-capability dependency and foundation graph
method: Every canonical capability was classified independently inside a non-overlapping domain lane.
Canonical status comes from the full-audit row when present and otherwise from the canonical execution ledger; lane labels never override it.
Layers describe implementation dependency, not product value or proof of support.
Capability edges are reviewed architectural sequencing judgments, not code-discovered coupling; raw centrality must not select foundations by itself.
Foundation candidates are proposals; tranche selection requires architecture and safety review.

layer_definitions.L0_invariant: Safety or correctness invariant that dependent workflows must preserve.
layer_definitions.L1_shared_foundation: Shared identity, authority, money, state, or storage primitive.
layer_definitions.L2_core_workflow: Merchant workflow assembled from L0/L1 foundations.
layer_definitions.L3_enhancement: Valuable extension that is not required to make the core safe.
layer_definitions.L4_vertical_or_adapter: Vertical-specific behavior, provider adapter, or benchmark-specific leaf.
